words.ex: The students handed in a petition to the principal.
words.ex_cn: 学生们向校长递交了一份请愿书。
words.en: A petition is a document signed by a lot of people which asks a government or other official group to do a particular thing.

words.tr: adj. 琐碎的；微不足道的；心胸狭窄的
words.ex: He got angry over a petty mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他因为一个微不足道的错误生气了。
words.en: If you describe someone's behavior as petty, you mean that they care too much about small, unimportant things and perhaps that they are unnecessarily unkind.

words.ex: The photoelectric cell converts light into electricity.
words.ex_cn: 光电管将光转化为电能。
words.en: Relating to the electrical effects of light, especially the emission of electrons from a surface when exposed to light.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.ex: He is physically tired after running five kilometers.
words.ex_cn: 他跑完五公里后身体上很累。
words.en: In a way that relates to the body as opposed to the mind; in a way that relates to things that can be seen or touched.

words.tr:
n. 泡菜；腌菜；腌汁；腌制品；困境
v. 腌制（泡菜等）
words.ex: He put a pickle on his sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他在三明治上放了一颗酸黄瓜。
words.en: A pickle is a vegetable or fruit that has been preserved in vinegar or salt water, or a difficult situation.

words.ex: The fisherman walked to the pier to check his nets.
words.ex_cn: 渔夫走到码头去检查他的渔网。
words.en: A pier is a platform sticking out into water, usually the sea, which people walk along or use when getting onto or off boats.

words.ex: The needle will pierce the skin.
words.ex_cn: 针会刺穿皮肤。
words.en: If a sharp object pierces something, or if you pierce something with a sharp object, the object goes into it and makes a hole in it.

words.ex: The pilgrim walked to the holy place.
words.ex_cn: 朝圣者步行前往圣地。
words.en: A pilgrim is a person who journeys to a sacred place for religious reasons.

words.ex: He eats a pineapple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个菠萝。
words.en: A pineapple is a large oval fruit with sweet, juicy, yellow flesh and thick, brown skin.

words.ex: The pirate sailed the sea with a black flag.
words.ex_cn: 海盗带着黑旗在海上航行。
words.en: A pirate is someone who attacks and robs ships at sea. The term can also refer to someone who illegally copies and distributes software, music, or films.

words.ex: The piston moves up and down in the engine.
words.ex_cn: 活塞在发动机中上下移动。
words.en: A piston is a component of reciprocating engines, reciprocating pumps, gas compressors and pneumatic cylinders, among other similar mechanisms. It is the moving component that is contained by a cylinder and is made gas-tight by piston rings.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.tr:
n. 瘟疫；疫病；
v. 困扰；折磨；
words.ex: The plague killed many people in medieval Europe.
words.ex_cn: 瘟疫在中世纪的欧洲杀死了许多人。
words.en: A plague is a very infectious disease that spreads quickly and kills a lot of people. It can also refer to a large number of insects or animals that cause damage or are a nuisance.

words.tr:
n. 平原；
adj. 简单明了的；朴素的；
words.ex: The cows graze on the plain.
words.ex_cn: 牛在平原上吃草。
words.en: If something is plain, it is easy to see, hear, or understand.

words.ex: The sheep graze on a high plateau.
words.ex_cn: 羊群在高高原上吃草。
words.en: A plateau is a large area of high and fairly flat land. It can also refer to a period during which there are no large changes.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: He made a plea for help.
words.ex_cn: 他恳求帮助。
words.en: A plea is a request or an appeal made in an urgent or emotional manner, or a statement made by someone in a court of law in which they say whether they are guilty of a crime or not.

words.tr: v. 恳求；辩护；答辩；以…为理由
words.ex: He pleaded for help when he was lost.
words.ex_cn: 当他迷路时，他恳求帮助。
words.en: If you plead with someone to do something, you ask them in an intense, emotional way to do it.

words.ex: He made a pledge to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了帮助穷人的保证。
words.en: A pledge is a serious promise or agreement, especially one made publicly or officially. It can also refer to something given as security for the fulfillment of a contract or the payment of a debt.

words.tr:
v. 摘；拔；猛拉；拨弹
n. 胆识；胆量；快而猛地拉
words.ex: He plucked a flower from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里摘了一朵花。
words.en: To pluck means to pull something quickly to remove it or to play a musical instrument by pulling the strings with your fingers. As a noun, it refers to the quality of being brave and determined.

words.tr:
adj. 丰满的；肥胖的
v. （使）圆胖；（使）鼓起
adv. 噗通地；直接地
words.ex: The baby has plump cheeks.
words.ex_cn: 这个婴儿有圆润的脸颊。
words.en: Having a full rounded shape; chubby.

words.tr:
v. 掠夺；抢劫
n. 掠夺物；掠夺；赃物
words.ex: The pirates plundered the ship.
words.ex_cn: 海盗劫掠了那艘船。
words.en: If someone plunders a place or plunders things from a place, they steal things from it.

words.tr:
adj. 气动的；风动的；充气的
n. 气胎
words.ex: The pneumatic drill makes loud noise.
words.ex_cn: 气动钻发出很大的噪音。
words.en: Pneumatic means relating to or operated by air or gas under pressure.

words.tr:
v. 戳；刺；捅
n. 戳；刺；捅
words.ex: He poked the fire with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根棍子戳了戳火。
words.en: To poke means to prod or jab someone or something with a finger or a pointed object, or to move something in a particular direction with a sharp movement. It can also refer to the act of making a hole or opening in something by pushing a pointed object into it.

words.ex: The polar bear lives in the Arctic.
words.ex_cn: 北极熊生活在北极。
words.en: relating to the North or South Pole or to the region around it; having opposite extremes or characteristics.

words.ex: The polarity of the magnet is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这个磁铁的极性很清晰。
words.en: Polarity refers to the state of having two opposite or contradictory tendencies, opinions, or aspects.

words.ex: He is interested in politics.
words.ex_cn: 他对政治感兴趣。
words.en: Politics are the actions or activities concerned with achieving and using power in a country or society. The verb that follows politics may be either singular or plural.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.ex: The bottle is made of a strong polymer.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子是由一种坚固的聚合物制成的。
words.en: A polymer is a chemical compound with molecules bonded together in long repeating chains. Because of their structure, polymers have unique properties that can be tailored for different uses.

words.ex: He sat by the window to ponder his future.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在窗边深思自己的未来。
words.en: If you ponder something, you think about it carefully.

words.tr:
n. 流行音乐；
v. 发出砰的一声；突然地行动；
words.ex: I love listening to pop on the radio.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在收音机里听流行音乐。
words.en: To make a short, sharp, explosive sound; to appear suddenly and unexpectedly.

words.tr:
n. 毛孔；小孔
v. 细看；钻研；凝视
words.ex: Sweat comes out through the pores of the skin.
words.ex_cn: 汗水通过皮肤上的毛孔排出。
words.en: A pore is a tiny opening in a surface that allows liquids or gases to pass through. As a verb, to pore means to read or study something very carefully.

words.ex: This portable charger works well on trips.
words.ex_cn: 这个便携式充电器在旅行时很好用。
words.en: Capable of being carried or moved about with ease.

words.ex: He bought a porcelain cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上买了一个瓷杯。
words.en: A hard, white, translucent ceramic that is made by firing a pure clay and then glazing it.

words.tr:
v. 引起（问题、危险等）；提出；
n. 姿势；
words.ex: Pollution can pose a serious threat to health.
words.ex_cn: 污染可能对健康造成严重威胁。
words.en: If you pose for a photograph or painting, you stay in a particular position so that someone can photograph you or paint you. / To pose a question or problem means to ask it or to present it.

words.tr: n. 位置；职位；地位；姿势；
words.ex: The book is on the table in a good position.
words.ex_cn: 书放在桌子上的一个好位置。
words.en: A position refers to the place or type of role someone has in a situation, organization, or society, or the way in which someone or something is placed or arranged.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.tr: phrase. 肯定地；积极地；确实地；绝对地
words.ex: She positively smiled when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 她听到这个消息时，开心地笑了。
words.en: in a positive manner; with certainty; absolutely

words.tr:
v. 假定；要求
n. 假定；假设
words.ex: He postulates that all humans are equal.
words.ex_cn: 他假定所有人都是平等的。
words.en: If you postulate something, you suggest it as the basis for a theory, argument, or calculation.

words.ex: There is a possibility of rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天有可能下雨。
words.en: A possibility is a situation that might happen or something that might be true.

words.ex: He buys poultry at the local market.
words.ex_cn: 他在当地市场买家禽。
words.en: Poultry refers to domesticated birds kept by humans for their eggs, meat, or feathers.

words.ex: The cows graze on the prairie.
words.ex_cn: 牛在草原上吃草。
words.en: A prairie is a large area of flat, grassy land, especially in North America.

words.ex: He preaches kindness every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都宣扬仁爱。
words.en: If you preach, you give a talk on a religious or moral subject during a religious service.

words.tr: n. 前任；前辈；原有事物
words.ex: He became the new manager, replacing his predecessor.
words.ex_cn: 他成为了新经理，接替了他的前任。
words.en: A predecessor is someone who had a job or a position before someone else, or something that comes before another thing in time or in a series.

words.ex: The rain precedes the storm.
words.ex_cn: 雨先于风暴来临。
words.en: If one event or period of time precedes another, it happens before it.

words.ex: This plan is practicable.
words.ex_cn: 这个计划是可行的。
words.en: If a task, plan, or idea is practicable, it can be successfully done or achieved.

words.ex: The predominant color in the room is blue.
words.ex_cn: 房间里的主导颜色是蓝色。
words.en: If something is predominant, it is more important, noticeable, or powerful than the other things in a situation.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.ex: He has prejudice against people from other countries.
words.ex_cn: 他对来自其他国家的人有偏见。
words.en: Prejudice is an unreasonable dislike of a particular group of people or things, or a preference for one group of people or things over another.

words.ex: The doctor wrote a prescription for medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生开了一张药方。
words.en: A prescription is a written order from a physician for the preparation and administration of a drug or device for a patient.

words.ex: He set the timer to preset mode.
words.ex_cn: 他把计时器设为预设模式。
words.en: To set or adjust something in advance.

words.ex: He gave a presentation about climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个关于气候变化的报告。
words.en: The act of showing or explaining something to an audience.

words.ex: The museum focuses on the preservation of old books.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆专注于旧书的保存。
words.en: The act of keeping something in its original state or in good condition.

words.tr: v. 主持；指挥；担任会议主席
words.ex: He presides over the meeting every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周一主持会议。
words.en: To preside means to be in charge of a formal meeting, ceremony, or other event.

words.tr:
n. 新闻界；出版社；
v. 按；压；
words.ex: The press reported the news quickly.
words.ex_cn: 新闻界迅速报道了这则新闻。
words.en: To press something is to push it firmly, often with your fingers or hand, in order to operate a device or machine, or to make something flat or smooth. It can also mean to urge someone to do something or to make a strong demand for something.

words.tr:
n. 压力；压强；
v. 对…施加压力；
words.ex: He feels pressure from his parents to get good grades.
words.ex_cn: 他感受到来自父母要取得好成绩的压力。
words.en: Pressure is the force that you produce when you press hard on something, or the force that is produced by a particular amount of gas or liquid in a confined space.

words.ex: He is presumably at home now.
words.ex_cn: 推测起来，他现在在家。
words.en: If you say that something is presumably the case, you mean that you think it is very likely to be the case, although you are not certain.

words.ex: I presume he will arrive tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假设他明天会到。
words.en: If you presume that something is the case, you think that it is the case, although you are not certain.

words.tr: adj. 普遍的；流行的；盛行的；
words.ex: Smoking is prevalent in that country.
words.ex_cn: 在那个国家，吸烟很普遍。
words.en: If a condition, practice, or belief is prevalent, it is common or widespread.

words.tr:
n. 猎物；受害者；受骗者；
v. 捕食；坑害；折磨；
words.ex: The lion chased its prey across the plain.
words.ex_cn: 狮子在平原上追逐它的猎物。
words.en: An animal that is hunted and killed by another for food.

words.ex: Handwashing is a simple prevention of disease.
words.ex_cn: 洗手是预防疾病的一种简单方法。
words.en: The act of stopping something from happening or arising.

words.tr:
v. 刺；竖起 
n. 刺痛；刺
words.ex: The thorn pricked her finger.
words.ex_cn: 刺扎了她的手指。
words.en: To prick means to make a small hole in something with a sharp point, or to cause a sharp, sudden pain. It can also refer to the act of piercing or the sensation of being pierced.

words.ex: The tribe lives in a primitive hut.
words.ex_cn: 这个部落住在原始的小屋里。
words.en: Belonging to a very early period in the history of the world, or to a time before modern things existed.

words.ex: He is principally responsible for the project.
words.ex_cn: 他主要负责这个项目。
words.en: Mainly; for the most part.

words.ex: The printer is out of paper.
words.ex_cn: 打印机没有纸了。
words.en: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: The prism splits sunlight into seven colors.
words.ex_cn: 棱镜将阳光分解成七种颜色。
words.en: A prism is a transparent optical element with flat, polished surfaces that refract light. At least two of the flat surfaces must have an angle between them. The exact angles between the surfaces depend on the application. The traditional geometrical shape is that of a triangular prism with a triangular base and rectangular sides, and in colloquial use 'prism' usually refers to this type.

words.tr:
n. 探测器；
v. 探查；
words.ex: The probe sent back photos from Mars.
words.ex_cn: 探测器从火星传回了照片。
words.en: If you probe into something, you ask questions or try to discover facts about it. A probe is also a long thin instrument that doctors and dentists use to examine parts of the body.

words.tr: v. 进行；继续；继续进行；“proceed”的现在分词；
words.ex: The meeting is proceeding as planned.
words.ex_cn: 会议按计划进行。
words.en: A proceeding is an event or a series of actions, especially one that is formal or official.

words.tr: n. 生产者；制造商；制片人；
words.ex: The farmer is a producer of milk.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民是牛奶的生产者。
words.en: A producer is a person or company that makes or grows things, or a person who controls and organizes the making of a film, play, or television or radio programme.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；多产的；生产的；
words.ex: He had a productive day and finished all his work.
words.ex_cn: 他度过了富有成效的一天，完成了所有工作。
words.en: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.

words.ex: He has great proficiency in English.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: If you show proficiency in something, you show ability or skill at it.

words.ex: He is proficient in playing the piano.
words.ex_cn: 他弹钢琴很熟练。
words.en: If you are proficient in something, you can do it well because you have learned how to do it.

words.ex: The factory improved its productivity by using new machines.
words.ex_cn: 工厂通过使用新机器提高了生产率。
words.en: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced or work is completed.

words.ex: This small business is profitable.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业有利可图的。
words.en: If something is profitable, it makes a profit or is beneficial.

words.ex: His words had a profound effect on her life.
words.ex_cn: 他的话对她的生活产生了深远的影响。
words.en: If you describe something as profound, you mean that it is very great or intense.

words.tr:
n. 节目；程序；
v. 编程；
words.ex: We watched a funny program on TV last night.
words.ex_cn: 我们昨晚在电视上看了一个有趣的节目。
words.en: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.

words.ex: The teacher turned on the projector to show the video.
words.ex_cn: 老师打开投影仪来播放视频。
words.en: A projector is a machine that projects films or slides onto a screen or wall.

words.ex: They decided to prolong the meeting by one hour.
words.ex_cn: 他们决定将会议延长一小时。
words.en: To prolong something means to make it last longer.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.tr: adv. 马上；迅速地；准时地；
words.ex: He answered the call promptly.
words.ex_cn: 他马上接了电话。
words.en: If you do something promptly, you do it immediately.

words.ex: The government used propaganda to influence people's opinions.
words.ex_cn: 政府使用宣传来影响人们的观点。
words.en: Information, especially of a biased or misleading nature, used to promote a political cause or point of view.

words.ex: The virus can propagate quickly among people.
words.ex_cn: 这种病毒可以在人群中迅速传播。
words.en: To propagate something means to spread it and encourage more people to believe in it or support it.

words.ex: The propagation of the rumor spread quickly.
words.ex_cn: 这个谣言的传播很快。
words.en: The act of spreading something, especially information or ideas, or the process by which plants or animals produce more of their own kind.

words.ex: The wind propels the sailboat forward.
words.ex_cn: 风推动帆船前进。
words.en: To propel something in a particular direction means to cause it to move in that direction.

words.ex: The boat has a large propeller at the back.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船后面有一个大的螺旋桨。
words.en: A propeller is a device with blades that is used to propel a vehicle such as a ship or an airplane.

words.tr: adj. 正确的；合适的；正当的；
words.ex: This is the proper way to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是解决这个问题的正确方法。
words.en: If something is proper, it is suitable or correct for a particular purpose, situation, or person.

words.ex: The old woman made a prophecy about the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言了会有雨。
words.en: A prophecy is a statement that something will happen in the future, especially one made by someone with religious or magical powers.

words.ex: The prophet told the people about the coming storm.
words.ex_cn: 预言者告诉人们即将到来的风暴。
words.en: A prophet is a person who is believed to be chosen by God to lead the people and to tell them what God wants them to do.

words.ex: He made a proposition to lower taxes.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了降低税收的建议。
words.en: A proposition is a statement or an idea that people can consider or discuss to decide whether it is true.

words.ex: He writes simple prose every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天写简单的散文。
words.en: Prose is written language in its ordinary form, without metrical structure.

words.ex: A proton has a positive charge.
words.ex_cn: 质子带正电。
words.en: A proton is a subatomic particle found in the nucleus of every atom. The particle has a positive electrical charge, equal and opposite to that of the electron.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.ex: He told me a proverb: 'Slow and steady wins the race.'
words.ex_cn: 他告诉我一句谚语：‘慢而稳，胜千里。’
words.en: A proverb is a short, commonly known saying that expresses a truth or piece of advice.

words.ex: He was born in the province of Guangdong.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在广东省。
words.en: A province is a large area of a country that has its own administration and often its own culture.

words.ex: The ship carries a provision of food for the journey.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船为旅程准备了食物供应。
words.en: A provision is a condition or requirement in a legal document. It can also refer to the act of supplying or providing something that is needed.

words.ex: His rude words provoked her anger.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话激怒了她。
words.en: If you provoke someone, you deliberately annoy them and try to make them behave aggressively.

words.tr: adj. 谨慎的；慎重的；精明的
words.ex: He is prudent with his money.
words.ex_cn: 他在花钱时很谨慎。
words.en: If you are prudent, you are careful and avoid taking unnecessary risks.

words.ex: He wants to study psychology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习心理学。
words.en: Psychology is the scientific study of the human mind and the reasons for people's behaviour.

words.ex: He puffed after running up the stairs.
words.ex_cn: 他跑上楼梯后喘着气。
words.en: If you puff, you breathe in and out quickly and with force, for example because you have been running or because you are out of breath. A puff of something such as air or smoke is a small amount of it that is blown out from somewhere.

words.ex: He used a pulley to lift the box.
words.ex_cn: 他用滑轮把箱子吊起来。
words.en: A pulley is a wheel with a grooved rim around which a cord passes. It acts to change the direction of a force applied to the cord and is chiefly used (typically in combination) to raise heavy weights.

words.ex: He punched the wall in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地打了墙一拳。
words.en: To punch means to hit someone or something hard with your fist, or to make a hole in something using a tool.

words.ex: The puppy is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小狗在玩球。
words.en: A puppy is a young dog.

words.ex: The machine purifies water by removing dirt.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器通过去除杂质来净化水。
words.en: To purify something means to make it clean and pure by removing dirty or harmful substances from it.

words.ex: He wears pyjamas to bed every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上穿睡衣睡觉。
words.en: Pyjamas are loose-fitting clothes consisting of trousers and a jacket that people, especially men, wear in bed.

words.ex: He got a teaching qualification last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年获得了教师资格。
words.en: A qualification is a skill or type of experience that you need in order to do a particular job or activity.

words.tr: v. 使合格；使具有资格；
words.ex: He studied hard to qualify for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习以获得这份工作的资格。
words.en: To qualify means to meet the necessary conditions or standards to be eligible for something or to perform a particular role.

words.ex: The study focuses on qualitative data, like people's feelings.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究关注定性数据，比如人们的感受。
words.en: relating to, measuring, or measured by the quality of something rather than its quantity.

words.ex: We need to quantify the results of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要量化实验的结果。
words.en: If you try to quantify something, you try to calculate how much of it there is.

words.ex: The study uses quantitative data to measure results.
words.ex_cn: 这项研究使用定量数据来测量结果。
words.en: Relating to, measuring, or measured by the quantity of something rather than its quality.

words.tr:
adj. 季度的；
adv. 每季一次；
words.ex: The company releases its quarterly report every three months.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司每三个月发布一次季度报告。
words.en: Something that happens quarterly happens four times a year, at intervals of three months.

words.ex: The clock has a quartz crystal inside.
words.ex_cn: 这个钟里面有一个石英晶体。
words.en: Quartz is a hard, crystalline mineral composed of silicon and oxygen atoms. It is one of the most common minerals in the Earth's continental crust.

words.tr: v. 熄灭；平息；抑制（欲望）；用水冷却
words.ex: He quenched the fire with water.
words.ex_cn: 他用水熄灭了火。
words.en: To satisfy one's thirst or to extinguish a fire or to suppress a feeling or desire.

words.ex: His quest for truth led him to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他对真理的探求使他环游世界。
words.en: A quest is a long or difficult search for something.

words.tr: adj. 可疑的；有问题的；不可靠的；
words.ex: The deal seemed questionable.
words.ex_cn: 这笔交易看起来可疑。
words.en: If you say that something is questionable, you mean that it is not obviously true or real, and therefore possibly not valid or reliable.

words.ex: The teacher gave us a questionnaire about our habits.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们一份关于我们习惯的问卷。
words.en: A questionnaire is a written list of questions which are answered by a lot of people in order to provide information for a report or a survey.

words.tr:
v. 颤抖；颤动；发抖
n. 颤抖
words.ex: The leaf quivers in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 树叶在风中颤抖。
words.en: To shake or tremble with a slight rapid motion; a case for carrying arrows.

words.tr:
adj. 辐射状的；放射式的；径向的；星形的
n. 子午线轮胎；辐射式轮胎
words.ex: The wheels have radial tires.
words.ex_cn: 这些车轮装有径向轮胎。
words.en: Relating to or situated near the radius or the radial side of the forearm or hand.

words.tr: adj. 发光的；辐射的；容光焕发的
words.ex: The radiant sun warmed the garden.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的太阳温暖了花园。
words.en: If you describe someone as radiant, you mean that they look very happy and healthy.

words.ex: The radiator is hot in the winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，散热器是热的。
words.en: A radiator is a device for heating a room or building, consisting of a series of pipes through which hot water or steam is circulated. It can also refer to a device for cooling an engine or other mechanism, typically consisting of a bank of thin tubes with fins attached, through which coolant flows.

words.tr: adj. 根本的；彻底的；激进的；
words.ex: The government made radical changes to the education system.
words.ex_cn: 政府对教育系统进行了根本性的改革。
words.en: A radical change or difference is very big and important.

words.ex: The new policy has a wide radius of influence.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策的影响范围很广。
words.en: A straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere.

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.ex: He eats a raisin every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一粒葡萄干。
words.en: A raisin is a dried grape.

words.tr:
v. 集合起来；振作；复苏
n. 集会
words.ex: The crowd rallied to support their team.
words.ex_cn: 人群聚集起来支持他们的球队。
words.en: A rally is a large public meeting that is held in order to show support for something such as a political party or a sports team. It can also mean to come together again in order to continue fighting or arguing after a defeat or a period of confusion.

words.ex: He likes to ramble about his travels.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢漫谈他的旅行经历。
words.en: To walk for pleasure, especially in the countryside, without a definite route or destination.

words.ex: He picked a random number to win the prize.
words.ex_cn: 他随意选了一个数字来赢得奖品。
words.en: If you describe something as random, you mean that it happens or is chosen without any definite plan, pattern, or purpose.

words.tr:
n. 一系列；（变化）范围；山脉；
v. （在某范围内）变化；包括（各种不同的人或物）；
words.ex: The store offers a range of colors.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供一系列颜色。
words.en: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

words.tr:
n. 说唱乐
v. 说唱；敲击
words.ex: He loves to rap about his life in the city.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢说唱自己在城市里的生活。
words.en: A type of music characterized by rhythmic and/or rhyming speech that is chanted or rapped.

words.ex: The car moved with rapidity.
words.ex_cn: 汽车以迅速的速度行驶。
words.en: the quality of moving or reacting with great speed

words.tr:
n. 狂喜；非常高兴
v. 使…狂喜
words.ex: She felt rapture when she saw the sunrise.
words.ex_cn: 当她看到日出时，感到无比欣喜。
words.en: A feeling of intense pleasure or joy.

words.ex: The little rascal stole my cookie.
words.ex_cn: 那个顽皮的孩子偷了我的饼干。
words.en: A rascal is a person who behaves badly or dishonestly but who is usually likable.

words.tr: n. 大量同时出现的事件；
words.ex: There was a rash of burglaries last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月发生了一连串的盗窃案。
words.en: If someone is rash or does rash things, they act without thinking carefully first, and therefore make mistakes or behave foolishly.

words.tr:
n. 率；速度；比率；价格；费用；
v. 被评价；定级；（被）认为；
words.ex: The interest rate is very low this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年的利率非常低。
words.en: A rate is the speed at which something happens or changes, or the amount or number of something that happens or changes in a particular period.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.tr:
n. 拨浪鼓；嘎嘎声；咔嗒声
v. 发出格格声；使紧张不安；喋喋不休
words.ex: The baby laughed while shaking the rattle.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝摇着拨浪鼓笑了。
words.en: If something rattles or if you rattle it, it makes short sharp knocking sounds as it moves or shakes.

words.ex: The reactor produces electricity for the city.
words.ex_cn: 这个反应堆为城市发电。
words.en: A reactor is a device or structure in which nuclear fission or fusion reactions are initiated, controlled, and sustained.

words.tr: adj. 现实的；现实主义的；
words.ex: He made a realistic plan to save money.
words.ex_cn: 他制定了一个现实的存钱计划。
words.en: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

words.ex: He had a realization that he needed to change his life.
words.ex_cn: 他领悟到自己需要改变生活。
words.en: The act of becoming fully aware of something as a fact; the achievement of something desired or anticipated.

words.tr:
n. 后部；
v. 饲养；抚养；
adj. 后面的；
words.ex: The rear of the car was damaged in the accident.
words.ex_cn: 汽车的后部在事故中受损了。
words.en: The back part of something, especially a building or vehicle; to bring up and care for a child until they are fully grown.

words.tr:
n. 原因；理由；理性；
v. 推理；推断；
words.ex: The reason for his absence is sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他缺席的原因是生病。
words.en: A reason is an explanation or justification for an action, belief, or occurrence.

words.tr:
v. 指责；斥责
n. 指责；谴责
words.ex: The teacher gave him a rebuke for talking in class.
words.ex_cn: 老师因为他上课讲话而责备了他。
words.en: If you rebuke someone, you speak severely to them because they have said or done something that you do not approve of.

words.ex: He picked up the receiver to answer the phone.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起听筒接电话。
words.en: A receiver is a person who receives something or a device that receives signals and converts them into sound or pictures.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.ex: They have a reciprocal agreement to help each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们有一个互相帮助的互惠协议。
words.en: A reciprocal action or agreement involves two people or groups who do the same thing to each other or agree to help each other in a similar way.

words.tr: adj. 鲁莽的；不计后果的；
words.ex: He drove reckless and got into an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他开车鲁莽，结果出了事故。
words.en: If you say that someone is reckless, you mean that they act in a way which shows that they do not care about danger or the effect their behaviour will have on other people.

words.ex: I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.

words.tr: v. 要求归还；收回；开垦；感化
words.ex: He wants to reclaim his lost wallet.
words.ex_cn: 他想要要求归还他丢失的钱包。
words.en: If you reclaim something that you have lost or that has been taken away from you, you succeed in getting it back. If you reclaim land, you make it suitable for use, for example by draining it or by getting rid of unwanted buildings or plants.

words.tr: n. 认可；识别；认识；承认；
words.ex: His hard work got recognition from his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他的努力得到了老板的认可。
words.en: The action or process of recognizing or being recognized, in particular.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: He tried to reconcile his work and family life.
words.ex_cn: 他试图调和工作与家庭生活。
words.en: If you reconcile two beliefs, facts, or demands that seem to be opposed or completely different, you find a way in which they can both be true or both be successful.

words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: He will rectify the mistake tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会纠正这个错误。
words.en: If you rectify something that is wrong, you change it so that it becomes correct or satisfactory.

words.ex: The reed grows near the river.
words.ex_cn: 芦苇长在河边。
words.en: A reed is a tall, thin plant that grows in water or marshy ground.

words.ex: The fish swim near the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在珊瑚礁附近游动。
words.en: A reef is a long line of rocks or sand, the top of which is just above or just below the surface of the sea.

words.ex: He wound the fishing line onto the reel.
words.ex_cn: 他把鱼线绕在卷筒上。
words.en: A reel is a cylinder on which film, wire, thread, or other flexible materials can be wound. It can also refer to a lively Scottish or Irish dance, or to the act of staggering or lurching violently.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.ex: The refinery makes gasoline from oil.
words.ex_cn: 炼油厂从石油中生产汽油。
words.en: A refinery is a factory where a substance such as oil or sugar is refined.

words.tr:
n. 经常重复的评价（或抱怨）；叠句；
v. 克制；
words.ex: His constant refrain is that the food is too expensive.
words.ex_cn: 他经常抱怨食物太贵。
words.en: If you refrain from doing something, you deliberately do not do it.

words.ex: We had a snack and some drinks as refreshment after the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 会议结束后，我们吃了点心和喝了一些饮料作为茶点。
words.en: Refreshment refers to the act of refreshing or the state of being refreshed, especially by food or drink. It can also mean a light meal or drinks served in a social setting.

words.ex: The refugee walked to a new country.
words.ex_cn: 这名难民步行去了一个新国家。
words.en: A refugee is a person who has been forced to leave their country in order to escape war, persecution, or natural disaster.

words.ex: This plant has regenerative powers.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物具有再生能力。
words.en: Relating to or characterized by regeneration; able to regrow or be renewed.

words.ex: The new regime changed the tax laws.
words.ex_cn: 新的管理制度改变了税法。
words.en: A regime is the set of rules or the way that a country or organization is governed, especially when it is considered to be strict or unfair.

words.tr:
n. （军队的）团；大群；大量
v. 把...编组；严格管制
words.ex: He joined the army and was in a regiment.
words.ex_cn: 他参军了，被编入一个团。
words.en: A regiment is a large group of soldiers that is commanded by a colonel.

words.ex: The regularity of his daily routine helps him stay focused.
words.ex_cn: 他日常作息的规律性帮助他保持专注。
words.en: The quality or state of being regular; the condition of being governed by or according to rules, principles, or established customs.

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.ex: The thermostat helps regulate the room temperature.
words.ex_cn: 恒温器有助于调节室温。
words.en: To regulate something means to control or manage it, especially by means of rules or laws.

words.ex: The queen's reign lasted 70 years.
words.ex_cn: 女王的统治持续了70年。
words.en: The period during which a sovereign rules; to hold royal office; to prevail

words.tr:
n. 接力赛；轮换者；
v. 传达；传递；
words.ex: The boys ran in the 4x100 meter relay.
words.ex_cn: 男孩们参加了4x100米接力赛。
words.en: A relay is a race between teams in which each team member runs or swims one section of the race. In electronics, a relay is a device that allows a small electrical current to control a larger one.

words.ex: He reject the job offer.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝了这份工作邀请。
words.en: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.ex: The remainder of the cake was given to the neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 蛋糕的剩余部分给了邻居。
words.en: The remainder is what is left over after other parts have been taken away or used.

words.ex: He will repay the loan next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月会偿还贷款。
words.en: If you repay a loan or a debt, you pay back the money that you owe to the person who you borrowed or took it from.

words.ex: The repeal of the old law took effect last month.
words.ex_cn: 这项旧法律的废止上个月生效了。
words.en: If the government repeals a law, it officially ends it, so that it is no longer valid.

words.ex: The smell repels insects.
words.ex_cn: 这种气味能击退昆虫。
words.en: If something repels you, it is so unpleasant or offensive that you want to avoid it or push it away.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: The teacher bought a replacement for the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 老师买了一把新椅子来替换坏掉的椅子。
words.en: The act of replacing something or someone, or the thing or person that replaces them.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful representation of nature.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是对自然的美丽表现。
words.en: A representation of something is a picture, a model of it, or a description of it that you create or that someone else creates for you.

words.tr:
n. 代表；典型事物；
adj. 典型的；有代表性的；代议制的；
words.ex: He is the representative of our class.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们班的代表。
words.en: A representative is a person who has been chosen to act or make decisions on behalf of another person or a group of people.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.ex: The reproduction of rabbits is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的生殖速度很快。
words.en: The process of producing offspring or new individuals of the same species, or the act of making a copy of something.

words.ex: A snake is a reptile.
words.ex_cn: 蛇是一种爬行动物。
words.en: A reptile is a cold-blooded vertebrate of the class Reptilia, including snakes, lizards, crocodiles, turtles, and tortoises. They are characterized by their scaly skin and the fact that they lay eggs on land.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；必备的；必不可少的；
words.ex: A passport is a requisite for international travel.
words.ex_cn: 护照是国际旅行所必需的。
words.en: Something that is necessary for a particular purpose.

words.ex: There is a resemblance between the two brothers.
words.ex_cn: 这两兄弟之间有相似之处。
words.en: If there is a resemblance between two people or things, they are similar to each other.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.ex: They reside in a small house near the park.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在公园附近的一所小房子里。
words.en: If someone resides somewhere, they live there or are staying there.

words.ex: He resents being ignored by his boss.
words.ex_cn: 他怨恨被老板忽视。
words.en: If you resent someone or something, you feel bitter and angry about them.

words.ex: I made a reservation for two at the restaurant.
words.ex_cn: 我在餐厅预订了两个人的座位。
words.en: A reservation is an arrangement whereby something, especially a seat or room, is kept for a particular person who will arrive later.

words.ex: The residual water dried up quickly.
words.ex_cn: 残留的水很快就干了。
words.en: Remaining after the greater part or quantity has gone.

words.tr:
adj. 居住的；常驻的；
n. 常住居民；
words.ex: The resident population grew last year.
words.ex_cn: 居住人口去年增加了。
words.en: A resident is someone who lives in a particular place or a person who has their home in a place.

words.ex: He handed in his resignation last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周递交了辞职信。
words.en: The act of giving up a job or position in a formal or official way; also refers to the acceptance of something undesirable but inevitable.

words.tr: adj. 坚决的；毅然的；有决心的；
words.ex: He was resolute in his decision to quit smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他决心戒烟。
words.en: If you describe someone as resolute, you approve of them because they are very determined not to change their mind or not to give up a course of action.

words.ex: He earned a respectable salary last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年挣了一份可观的薪水。
words.en: Someone or something that is respectable is approved of by society and considered to be morally correct.

words.ex: His response to the question was quick.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题的反应很快。
words.en: A reaction to a situation or event.

words.tr: adj. 有责任的；负责任的；
words.ex: He is responsible for cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他负责打扫房间。
words.en: If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

words.ex: He tries to restrain his anger.
words.ex_cn: 他努力克制自己的愤怒。
words.en: If you restrain someone, you stop them from doing what they intended or wanted to do, usually by using your physical strength.

words.tr:
adj. 作为结果的；合成的
n. 结果；产物
words.ex: The resultant force moved the box forward.
words.ex_cn: 合力把箱子向前推了。
words.en: A resultant thing or situation is the one that follows or is caused by a particular event or action.

words.ex: After a short break, he resumed his work.
words.ex_cn: 短暂休息后，他继续工作。
words.en: If you resume an activity or if it resumes, it begins again or continues after an interruption.

words.ex: He works in retail at a small store.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家小店从事零售工作。
words.en: The sale of goods to the public in relatively small quantities for use or consumption rather than for resale.

words.ex: The rain will retard the construction of the road.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会延迟道路的建设。
words.en: To retard something means to delay it or make it happen more slowly than it would otherwise.

words.ex: He plans to start his retirement next year.
words.ex_cn: 他计划明年退休。
words.en: Retirement is the period of one's life after leaving one's job and ceasing to work.

words.tr:
v. 反驳；回嘴
n. 反驳；顶嘴
words.ex: He gave a quick retort when she criticized him.
words.ex_cn: 当她批评他时，他迅速回了一句。
words.en: If you retort, you reply angrily to someone.

words.ex: The letter revealed his secret.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他的秘密。
words.en: To reveal something means to make known something that was previously secret or unknown.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.tr:
n. 反面；
v. 使倒转；（使）倒车；撤销；
words.ex: The reverse of the coin has a picture of a tree.
words.ex_cn: 硬币的反面有一棵树的图案。
words.en: If you reverse the order of a set of things, you arrange them in the opposite order, so that the first thing comes last.

words.ex: The medicine helped revive the sick man.
words.ex_cn: 这剂药帮助这位病人恢复了生机。
words.en: To revive something means to bring it back to life, consciousness, or use, or to make it active or successful again.

words.ex: The Earth revolves around the Sun.
words.ex_cn: 地球围绕太阳转。
words.en: If something revolves or if you revolve something, it moves or turns around a central point or line.

words.ex: He faced ridicule for wearing old clothes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为穿旧衣服而遭到嘲笑。
words.en: To ridicule someone or something means to make fun of them in an unkind way.

words.tr: adj. 严格的；缜密的；严密的；
words.ex: The teacher is rigorous about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 老师对作业截止日期要求严格。
words.en: If you are rigorous in something, you are very thorough and strict in the way you do it.

words.ex: The bike has a shiny metal rim.
words.ex_cn: 这辆自行车有一个闪亮的金属轮圈。
words.en: The outer edge of something, especially a circular object.

words.ex: Rinse the dishes with water before drying them.
words.ex_cn: 在晾干盘子之前用清水冲洗。
words.en: To rinse something means to wash it in clean water in order to remove soap or dirt.

words.ex: The riot broke out after the game.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后爆发了骚乱。
words.en: A riot is a violent disturbance of the peace by a crowd.

words.ex: The child ripped the paper with his hands.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用手把纸撕裂了。
words.en: To rip something means to tear it quickly and forcefully.

words.tr:
v. （使）成波浪状；（使）起涟漪；作潺潺声 
n. 微波；涟漪；潺潺声
words.ex: The wind ripples the surface of the lake.
words.ex_cn: 风使湖面泛起波浪。
words.en: If something ripples, it moves in small waves or if you ripple it, you make it move in small waves.

words.tr: phrase. 漫游；闲逛；漫步；流浪
words.ex: He likes to roam in the forest after work.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢下班后在森林里漫步。
words.en: To move about freely over a wide area.

words.ex: The painter used a roller to apply the paint.
words.ex_cn: 油漆工用滚筒来涂油漆。
words.en: A roller is a cylinder that rotates around a central axis and is used in various machines and devices to move, flatten, or compress something.

words.tr:
adj. 古罗马的；罗马人的；
n. 古罗马人；
words.ex: The ancient roman roads are still visible today.
words.ex_cn: 古老的罗马道路至今仍清晰可见。
words.en: A Roman is a person who comes from Rome or is connected with Rome. It can also refer to the style of printing or writing that uses upright letters, as opposed to italic.

words.ex: They wrote a love letter every day, and it became their romance.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天写一封情书，这成为了他们的浪漫史。
words.en: Romance refers to the feelings and behaviors characteristic of love, especially in its early stages, or a story, movie, or other work dealing with love in a sentimental or idealized way.

words.ex: He gave her a romantic gift on Valentine's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他在情人节送了她一份浪漫的礼物。
words.en: If you describe something as romantic, you mean that it is connected with love or with a feeling of excitement and mystery associated with love.

words.ex: The rooster crows every morning.
words.ex_cn: 公鸡每天早上打鸣。
words.en: A rooster is an adult male chicken.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.ex: The car turned at the roundabout near the park.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在公园附近的环形交叉路口转弯。
words.en: A roundabout is a circular area at a place where several roads meet. You drive round it until you come to the road that you want.

words.tr:
n. 常规；例行公事；
adj. 常规的；例行公事的；
words.ex: He follows a morning routine every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都遵循固定的惯例。
words.en: A routine is a sequence of actions regularly followed; a fixed program.

words.ex: The students sat in a row.
words.ex_cn: 学生们坐成一排。
words.en: A row is a straight line of things or people. To row means to move a boat through water using oars.

words.ex: The royalty lived in a large palace.
words.ex_cn: 皇族住在一座大宫殿里。
words.en: Royalty refers to people of royal blood or status, or a sum of money paid to an author, composer, etc., for each copy of a work sold or for each public performance of their work.

words.ex: She wears a ruby ring on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚红宝石戒指。
words.en: A ruby is a precious stone that is typically a deep red color.

words.tr:
n. 规则；统治；
v. 统治；
words.ex: The teacher made a new rule for homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师制定了一个新的作业规则。
words.en: A rule is a statement telling people what they should do in order to achieve success or a benefit of some kind.

words.tr: adj. 无情的；冷酷的；残忍的；
words.ex: The ruthless boss fired employees without warning.
words.ex_cn: 这位无情的老板未经警告就解雇了员工。
words.en: If you say that someone is ruthless, you mean that you disapprove of them because they are very harsh or cruel, and will do anything that is necessary to achieve what they want.

words.ex: The fence safeguards the garden from animals.
words.ex_cn: 围栏保护花园免受动物侵扰。
words.en: A safeguard is a measure taken to protect someone or something from potential harm or danger.

words.tr: n. 鲑鱼；三文鱼；大马哈鱼；
words.ex: He grilled salmon for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他烤了鲑鱼当晚餐。
words.en: A salmon is a large silver-coloured fish which lives in the sea and rivers.

words.tr:
n. 敬礼；致敬；行礼
v. 敬礼；致敬；行礼
words.ex: The soldier gave a salute to the officer.
words.ex_cn: 士兵向军官敬礼。
words.en: If you salute someone, you greet them or show your respect with a formal sign. Soldiers usually salute officers by raising their right hand so that their fingers touch their forehead.

words.ex: He eats a sandwich for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃三明治。
words.en: A sandwich consists of two slices of bread with a layer of food such as cheese or meat between them.

words.tr: n. 沙丁鱼；沙丁鱼罐头
words.ex: He ate a sardine for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一条沙丁鱼。
words.en: A small fish that is often canned and eaten as food.

words.ex: The satellite sends pictures from space.
words.ex_cn: 卫星从太空发送图片。
words.en: A satellite is an object which has been sent into space in order to collect information or to be part of a communications system. Satellites move continually round the earth or around another planet.

words.ex: He felt satisfaction after finishing his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他完成作业后感到满意。
words.en: The feeling of pleasure that you have when you do or get something that you wanted or needed.

words.ex: He completed the task satisfactorily.
words.ex_cn: 他把任务完成了得很好。
words.en: In a manner that fulfills expectations or needs adequately.

words.ex: The sponge reached saturation and could not hold more water.
words.ex_cn: 海绵达到饱和，再也吸不下更多水了。
words.en: Saturation is the state or process that occurs when no more of something can be absorbed, combined with, or added.

words.ex: Saturn has beautiful rings around it.
words.ex_cn: 土星周围有美丽的光环。
words.en: Saturn is the sixth planet from the Sun in the Solar System and is known for its prominent ring system, which is composed mainly of ice particles with a smaller amount of rocky debris and dust.

words.ex: He scan the QR code with his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他用手机扫描了二维码。
words.en: To look at something carefully or quickly in order to find out specific information or to examine something thoroughly.

words.ex: The scandal made the news last week.
words.ex_cn: 这起丑闻上周上了新闻。
words.en: A scandal is a situation or event that is thought to be shocking and immoral and that everyone knows about.

words.ex: He has a scar on his arm from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上有一道事故留下的伤疤。
words.en: A mark left on the skin after a wound or injury has healed, or the act of causing such a mark.

words.ex: The scarcity of water caused problems in the village.
words.ex_cn: 水的缺乏给村庄带来了问题。
words.en: A scarcity of something is a situation in which there is not enough of it.

words.tr: adj. 深红的；绯红的；猩红的；
words.ex: The scarlet leaves fell in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 深红色的叶子在秋天飘落。
words.en: A brilliant red color.

words.ex: The police discovered a scheme to steal money.
words.ex_cn: 警方发现了一个偷钱的阴谋。
words.en: A scheme is a plan or arrangement, especially one produced by a government or other organization, or a secret plan to do something, especially something illegal or dishonest.

words.ex: He won a scholarship to study at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一项去哈佛学习的奖学金。
words.en: A scholarship is a grant or payment made to support a student's education, awarded on the basis of academic or other achievement.

words.tr:
n. 嘲笑；嘲弄
v. 嘲笑；狼吞虎咽
words.ex: His joke received a scoff from the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他的笑话引来了人群的嘲笑。
words.en: If you scoff at something, you speak about it in a way that shows you think it is ridiculous or inadequate.

words.ex: The scope of this project includes three cities.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的范围包括三个城市。
words.en: The range of one's perceptions, thoughts, or actions.

words.ex: The sun scorch the ground in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天阳光灼烧地面。
words.en: To burn the surface of something so as to discolour or damage it.

words.tr:
n. 侦察兵；
v. 搜寻；
words.ex: The scout watched the enemy's movement quietly.
words.ex_cn: 侦察兵悄悄观察敌人的动向。
words.en: A scout is someone who is sent to an area of countryside to find out the position of an enemy or to search for a suitable place for a military camp.

words.ex: There was a scramble for the last ticket.
words.ex_cn: 大家争相抢购最后一张票。
words.en: If you scramble over rocks or up a hill, you move quickly over them or up it using your hands to help you. Scramble can also mean to compete or struggle with others for something that is in short supply.

words.tr:
n. 小块；碎片；废金属；吵架
v. 废弃；取消
adj. 废弃的
words.ex: He picked up a scrap of paper from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起一张纸片。
words.en: A scrap is a small piece or amount of something, especially one that is left over after the greater part has been used. It can also mean to discard or get rid of something as being no longer useful or necessary.

words.tr:
n. 抓痕；刮伤；
v. 抓搔；刮；
words.ex: The cat left a scratch on the door.
words.ex_cn: 猫在门上抓出了一道抓痕。
words.en: If you scratch something, you rub your fingernails or claws against it, often because it is itchy or irritating.

words.ex: The deer walked through the scrub near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 鹿穿过了山边的灌木丛。
words.en: To scrub something means to rub it hard in order to clean it, especially using a stiff brush and water.

words.tr: n. 雕刻（术）；雕塑品；雕刻品；
words.ex: He made a beautiful sculpture from clay.
words.ex_cn: 他用黏土做了一件精美的雕刻。
words.en: Sculpture is the art of making two- or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.

words.tr:
n. 接缝；缝合处；矿层；煤层
v. 缝合；有裂痕
words.ex: The seam of the shirt came loose.
words.ex_cn: 衬衫的接缝松开了。
words.en: A seam is a line where two pieces of fabric are sewn together in a garment or other article.

words.tr: n. 海港；港口；港口城市
words.ex: The seaport was bustling with activity as ships were loading and unloading cargo.
words.ex_cn: 海港里船只正在装卸货物，一片繁忙的景象。
words.en: A seaport is a town or city with a harbor where ships load and unload.

words.ex: We walked along the seaside at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 我们在日落时沿着海边散步。
words.en: The area by the sea, especially a beach area where people go for holidays.

words.tr:
adj. 第二的；
n. 第二；秒；片刻；
adv. 第二；
words.ex: He got the second prize in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第二名。
words.en: Second is used to describe something that is next after the first in order, rank, importance, or occurrence.

words.ex: This book has five sections.
words.ex_cn: 这本书有五个部分。
words.en: A section of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.tr: adv. 似乎；看似；表面上看；
words.ex: He is seemingly calm, but he is nervous inside.
words.ex_cn: 他似乎很平静，但内心很紧张。
words.en: appearing to be true or real but not necessarily so

words.ex: This segment of the book is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的这一部分非常有趣。
words.en: A segment of something is one of the parts into which it is divided or from which it is formed.

words.ex: The selection of books was very good.
words.ex_cn: 书籍的选择非常好。
words.en: The act of carefully choosing someone or something as the best or most suitable.

words.ex: The senator speaks to the people every week.
words.ex_cn: 这位参议员每周都对人民讲话。
words.en: A senator is a member of a senate, which is a governing body in many countries, especially in the United States.

words.ex: The cold water gave her a sudden sensation.
words.ex_cn: 冷水给了她一种突然的感觉。
words.en: A sensation is a physical feeling or a reaction of interest or excitement that something causes in a person or in a group of people.

words.tr: adj. 失去知觉的；无意义的；无目的的；不明智的
words.ex: After the accident, he was senseless on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他倒在地下，失去了知觉。
words.en: If you describe an action as senseless, you think it is wrong because it has no purpose and produces no benefit.

words.tr: adj. 明智的；有判断力的；恰当的；合理的；
words.ex: It is sensible to wear a coat in cold weather.
words.ex_cn: 在寒冷的天气里穿外套是明智的。
words.en: A sensible person is able to make good judgments and decisions based on reason rather than emotion.

words.ex: His sensitivity to loud noises makes him wear earplugs.
words.ex_cn: 他对噪音的敏感性让他戴耳塞。
words.en: Sensitivity is the quality or condition of being sensitive—the capacity to respond to slight changes, signals, or influences.

words.ex: The robot uses a sensor to detect walls.
words.ex_cn: 机器人使用传感器来检测墙壁。
words.en: A sensor is a device which reacts to certain physical conditions or impressions such as heat or light, and which is used to provide information.

words.ex: The sequence of numbers is 1, 2, 3, 4.
words.ex_cn: 这些数字的顺序是1、2、3、4。
words.en: A sequence is a set of related events, movements, or items that follow each other in a particular order.

words.tr: phrase. 情感集合；情绪组合（指一组相关的情感或情绪状态）
words.ex: He has a sentiment set against loud music.
words.ex_cn: 他对吵闹的音乐有反感。
words.en: A particular attitude or feeling towards something.

words.ex: The priest gave a long sermon about kindness.
words.ex_cn: 牧师做了一场关于仁爱的长时间布道。
words.en: A sermon is a talk on a religious or moral subject, especially one given during a church service.

words.tr: n. 定居点；定居（过程）；协议；
words.ex: The small settlement near the river has five houses.
words.ex_cn: 河边的小定居点有五所房子。
words.en: A settlement is an official agreement intended to resolve a dispute or conflict.

words.tr: adj. 严重的；严厉的；非常困难的；
words.ex: The storm caused severe damage to the houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴对房屋造成了严重的破坏。
words.en: If something is severe, it is very bad or very serious.

words.tr: adj. 破旧的；肮脏破烂的；衣衫褴褛的
words.ex: He wore a shabby coat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件破旧的外套去学校。
words.en: If you describe something as shabby, you mean that it looks old and is in poor condition.

words.tr:
n. 荫；阴影；
v. 遮蔽；
words.ex: The tree provides shade on a hot day.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树在炎热的日子提供荫凉。
words.en: Shade is an area where there is no direct sunlight, or something that provides protection from the sun. It can also refer to a slight difference in color, or to gradually change from one color or tone to another.

words.ex: The shady spot under the tree is cool.
words.ex_cn: 树下的背阴处很凉爽。
words.en: If you describe a person or activity as shady, you mean that they seem dishonest or illegal.

words.ex: The rod is a long shaft made of metal.
words.ex_cn: 这根杆是一根长金属杆。
words.en: A shaft is a long, narrow part or section forming the handle of a tool or club, the body of a spear or arrow, or a long, narrow, typically vertical hole that gives access to a mine, accommodates a lift, or provides ventilation.

words.tr:
n. 假象；假冒者；冒牌货
adj. 虚假的
v. 假装
words.ex: The gift was a sham, not real.
words.ex_cn: 这份礼物是假的，不是真的。
words.en: A sham is something that is not what it appears to be and is intended to deceive people.

words.ex: He felt shame for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对母亲撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: A painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behavior.

words.ex: A shark swam near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 一条鲨鱼在海滩附近游动。
words.en: A shark is a large fish that lives in the sea and has very sharp teeth.

words.ex: The price rose sharply last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月价格急剧上涨。
words.en: In a sharp manner; with a sharp edge or point; abruptly; severely.

words.tr: v. 使粉碎；使破碎；使破灭；
words.ex: The stone shattered when it hit the ground.
words.ex_cn: 石头撞到地面时碎裂了。
words.en: If something shatters or is shattered, it breaks into a lot of small pieces.

words.ex: It was sheer luck that he won the game.
words.ex_cn: 他赢了比赛完全是运气。
words.en: Sheer is used to emphasize that a state or situation is complete and does not involve or is not mixed with anything else.

words.tr:
n. 壳体；贝壳；炮弹；
v. 剥…的壳；去…的皮；炮轰；炮击；
words.ex: The crab crawled out of its shell.
words.ex_cn: 螃蟹从它的壳里爬了出来。
words.en: A shell is the hard protective outer case of a mollusk or crustacean, or the outer layer of an egg, nut, or seed. It can also refer to a metal case filled with explosive, to be fired from a gun.

words.tr: n. 郡长；行政司法长官；警长；县治安官
words.ex: The sheriff caught the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警长昨晚抓到了小偷。
words.en: A sheriff is an elected official who is responsible for enforcing the law in a county or region.

words.ex: He works in shipbuilding near the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他在海边从事造船工作。
words.en: The industry or activity of building ships.

words.ex: The shipment arrived on time.
words.ex_cn: 运输按时到达了。
words.en: The act of sending goods from one place to another, especially by ship.

words.ex: The old shipwreck lies at the bottom of the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船的残骸躺在海底。
words.en: A shipwreck is the destruction of a ship at sea by sinking or breaking up, for example in a storm or after hitting a rock.

words.ex: There is a shortage of clean water in the village.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的清洁用水不足。
words.en: A shortage is a situation in which there is not enough of something that is needed.

words.ex: He found a shortcut to school.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一条去学校的捷径。
words.en: A quicker or more direct way to get somewhere or do something.

words.ex: We need to shorten the meeting to one hour.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要把会议缩短到一小时。
words.en: To make something shorter in length, duration, or extent.

words.ex: He wrote the note in shorthand.
words.ex_cn: 他用速记法写了这条笔记。
words.en: A method of rapid writing by means of abbreviations and symbols, used especially for taking dictation.

words.ex: You should eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 你应该多吃蔬菜。
words.en: You use 'should' when you are saying what would be the right thing to do or the right state for something to be in.

words.ex: He rubbed his shoulder after lifting the box.
words.ex_cn: 他搬完箱子后揉了揉肩膀。
words.en: The part of the body at each side of the neck where the upper limb or forelimb is attached; to accept or take on (a responsibility or task).

words.ex: He shoved his way through the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他挤过人群。
words.en: To push someone or something in a rough or careless way.

words.tr:
n. 铲；铁锹
v. 铲；铲起
words.ex: He uses a shovel to dig the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子挖花园。
words.en: A shovel is a tool with a long handle and a broad blade or scoop, used for moving material such as earth, snow, or coal.

words.ex: I take a shower every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上都洗淋浴。
words.en: A shower is a device that sprays water over you so that you can wash yourself. It is also a short period of rain or snow.

words.tr:
adj. 刺耳的；尖声的；尖厉的
v. 尖叫；发出刺耳的声音
words.ex: The baby's cry was shrill.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿的哭声很尖锐。
words.en: A shrill sound is high and unpleasant to listen to.

words.ex: He ate grilled shrimp for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃了烤虾。
words.en: A shrimp is a small shellfish with a long tail and many legs, which can be eaten as food.

words.tr: n. 神龛；神社；圣地；圣殿
words.ex: People visit the shrine to pray.
words.ex_cn: 人们去神社祈祷。
words.en: A shrine is a place of worship which is associated with a particular holy person or object.

words.ex: The shrub grows near the fence.
words.ex_cn: 这丛灌木长在篱笆附近。
words.en: A shrub is a woody plant which is smaller than a tree and has several main stems arising at or near the ground.

words.tr:
n. 耸肩
v. 耸肩
words.ex: He shrugged when asked why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 当被问到为什么迟到时，他耸了耸肩。
words.en: If you shrug, you raise your shoulders to show that you are not interested in something or that you do not know or care about something.

words.ex: He pressed the shutter to take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 他按下快门拍了一张照片。
words.en: A shutter is a device used to cover or uncover a window or a camera lens.

words.tr: n. 往返移动之物；航天飞机；
words.ex: The bus is a shuttle between the hotel and the airport.
words.ex_cn: 这辆巴士是酒店和机场之间的往返交通工具。
words.en: A shuttle is a vehicle that travels frequently between two places. In weaving, a shuttle is a device used to carry the weft thread back and forth across the loom.

words.ex: He walked sideways to avoid the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 他斜着走以避开水坑。
words.en: Moving or directed toward one side.

words.ex: The castle endured a long siege during the war.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡在战争中经历了长期的围攻。
words.en: A siege is a military operation in which enemy forces surround a town or building, cutting off essential supplies, with the aim of compelling those inside to surrender.

words.ex: She sifts flour through a fine mesh.
words.ex_cn: 她用细网筛面粉。
words.en: To sift means to put a fine, loose, or powdery substance through a sieve so as to remove lumps or large particles. It can also mean to examine something thoroughly so as to isolate that which is most important or useful.

words.ex: He lost sight of the bird flying away.
words.ex_cn: 他看不见那只飞走的鸟了。
words.en: The ability to see; the act of seeing or the thing seen.

words.tr:
v. 做标记；签名；
n. 征兆；手势；符号；标志；告示牌；
words.ex: Sign the box with a checkmark.
words.ex_cn: 用对勾在盒子上做标记。
words.en: A sign is a mark or shape that always has a particular meaning, for example in mathematics or music. It can also be an event, action, or fact that shows that something exists, is happening, or may happen in the future.

words.tr: adj. 重大的；重要的；影响明显的；
words.ex: This discovery is a significant step forward.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现是一个重大的进步。
words.en: Something that is significant is important or large enough to be noticed or to have an effect.

words.ex: The phone has a silicon chip inside.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机内部有一个硅芯片。
words.en: Silicon is a chemical element with the symbol Si and atomic number 14. It is a hard, brittle crystalline solid with a blue-grey metallic lustre, and is a tetravalent metalloid and semiconductor.

words.ex: The similarity between the two paintings is clear.
words.ex_cn: 这两幅画的相似点很明显。
words.en: The quality or state of being similar; likeness or resemblance.

words.ex: This is a simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 这是一道简单的数学题。
words.en: If you describe something as simple, you mean that it is not complicated, and is therefore easy to understand.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.ex_cn: 这两个事件同时发生了。
words.en: Happening, existing, or done at the same time.

words.ex: He spoke with sincerity.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地说话。
words.en: Sincerity is the quality of being free from pretense, deceit, or hypocrisy.

words.tr: adj. 单个的；单数的；特异的；
words.ex: Each singular student must submit a form.
words.ex_cn: 每个学生都必须提交一份表格。
words.en: In grammar, singular means relating to or being a form of a word that refers to one person or thing.

words.tr:
n. 洗涤槽；水槽；
v. （使）沉没；
words.ex: The dirty dishes are in the sink.
words.ex_cn: 脏盘子在水槽里。
words.en: If a boat sinks, or if something sinks it, it disappears below the surface of a mass of water.

words.ex: The siren sounded loudly as the fire truck rushed by.
words.ex_cn: 消防车疾驰而过时，警报器发出了响亮的声音。
words.en: A siren is a device that makes a loud prolonged sound as a signal or warning. It can also refer to a woman who is considered to be alluring or fascinating but also dangerous.

words.ex: The situation is very serious.
words.ex_cn: 这种情况非常严重。
words.en: A situation is all the circumstances and things that are happening at a particular time and in a particular place.

words.tr: adj. 位于…的；处于…的境地的； v. 使位于；使坐落于；“situate”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The house is situated near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子位于湖边。
words.en: If something is situated in a particular place or position, it is in that place or position.

words.ex: The skeleton of the dinosaur is displayed in the museum.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙的骨架在博物馆里展出。
words.en: The internal structure that supports and gives shape to a person, animal, or plant, composed of bones and cartilage in vertebrates.

words.ex: The skyscraper is very tall and has many floors.
words.ex_cn: 这座摩天大楼非常高，有很多层。
words.en: A skyscraper is a very tall building that has many floors.

words.ex: The rope is slack and hangs loosely.
words.ex_cn: 绳子是松弛的，垂挂着。
words.en: If something is slack, it is loose and not firmly stretched or tightly in position. It can also describe a period of low activity or a lack of effort in work or activity.

words.tr:
v. 诋毁；诽谤；中伤
n. 诋毁；诽谤；中伤
words.ex: He spread slander about his neighbor.
words.ex_cn: 他散布了关于他邻居的诽谤。
words.en: Slander is the action or crime of making a false spoken statement damaging to a person's reputation.

words.ex: He uses a lot of slang when talking with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友聊天时用很多俚语。
words.en: Slang refers to a type of language that consists of words and phrases that are regarded as very informal, are more common in speech than writing, and are typically restricted to a particular context or group of people.

words.tr:
v. 拍；掴；拍击
n. 拍；掴；拍击
words.ex: He slapped the table in anger.
words.ex_cn: 他生气地拍了桌子。
words.en: If you slap someone, you hit them with the palm of your hand.

words.tr:
v. 屠宰；屠杀
n. 屠宰；屠杀
words.ex: Farmers slaughter pigs for meat.
words.ex_cn: 农民宰猪取肉。
words.en: The killing of animals for food; the killing of a large number of people in a cruel or violent way.

words.ex: The slave worked in the fields every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个奴隶每天在田地里劳作。
words.en: A slave is someone who is the legal property of another person and is forced to obey them.

words.tr:
n. 幻灯片；滑梯；
v. （使）滑动；下滑；
words.ex: He showed a slide of his vacation photos.
words.ex_cn: 他展示了一张他度假照片的幻灯片。
words.en: To move smoothly along a surface while maintaining continuous contact with it; to pass or move quietly or smoothly; a structure with a smooth sloping surface for children to slide down; a decline from a higher to a lower level or status.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: The slit in the curtain let in a thin beam of light.
words.ex_cn: 窗帘上的裂缝透进了一束细光。
words.en: A long, narrow cut or opening.

words.tr:
v. 睡眠
n. 睡眠（常复数）
words.ex: The baby fell into a deep slumber after feeding.
words.ex_cn: 宝宝喂完奶后进入了深深的睡眠。
words.en: Slumber is a state of sleep, especially one that is peaceful and restful.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.ex: He tried to smuggle cigarettes across the border.
words.ex_cn: 他试图走私香烟过境。
words.en: To smuggle goods or people means to move them into or out of a country illegally.

words.ex: Children like to eat snacks after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们喜欢在放学后吃零食。
words.en: Snacks are small amounts of food that are eaten between meals.

words.ex: The snail moves slowly across the garden.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛慢慢地爬过花园。
words.en: A snail is a small creature with a soft, wet body and a spiral shell. It moves very slowly.

words.tr:
n. 快照；
v. 突然断裂；猛然咬；
adj. 突然的；匆忙的；
words.ex: He took a snap of the sunset.
words.ex_cn: 他拍了一张日落的快照。
words.en: If something snaps or if you snap it, it breaks suddenly, usually with a sharp cracking noise. | A snap is a photograph. | If someone snaps, or if something snaps inside them, they suddenly stop being calm and become very angry.

words.tr:
v. 嘲笑；讥讽
n. 嘲笑；讥讽
words.ex: He sneered at her simple answer.
words.ex_cn: 他嗤之以鼻地对待她的简单答案。
words.en: If you sneer at someone or something, you express your contempt for them by the expression on your face or by what you say.

words.tr:
n. 喷嚏；喷嚏声
v. 打喷嚏
words.ex: He had a cold and let out a loud sneeze.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，打了一个响亮的喷嚏。
words.en: To sneeze is to suddenly expel air from the nose and mouth due to irritation in the nasal passages.

words.ex: He gave a sniff of the flower.
words.ex_cn: 他闻了闻那朵花。
words.en: To sniff is to breathe in air through your nose in a way that makes a noise, especially when you are trying to smell something or when you have a cold.

words.tr: n. 势利小人；谄上欺下的人；恃才傲物的人
words.ex: He acts like a snob because he only likes expensive things.
words.ex_cn: 他只喜欢昂贵的东西，所以表现得像个势利小人。
words.en: A snob is someone who thinks they are better than other people because they are more intelligent, more cultured, or of a higher social class.

words.tr: adj. 势利的；谄上欺下的
words.ex: He is snobbish and ignores people who are not rich.
words.ex_cn: 他很势利，不理睬不富有的人。
words.en: If you describe someone as snobbish, you disapprove of them because they are too proud of their social status, intelligence, or taste.

words.tr:
v. 打鼾；打呼噜
n. 打呼噜（声）；打鼾（声）
words.ex: He snores loudly when he sleeps.
words.ex_cn: 他睡觉时打呼噜很响。
words.en: To breathe noisily through your mouth and nose while you are asleep.

words.ex: He is taking sociology at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学里学习社会学。
words.en: Sociology is the study of society, patterns of social relationships, social interaction, and culture that surrounds everyday life.

words.ex: He adds sodium to his food for taste.
words.ex_cn: 他为了味道在食物里加钠。
words.en: Sodium is a soft, silvery-white, highly reactive metal. Sodium is an alkali metal, being in group 1 of the periodic table, because it has a single electron in its outer shell that it readily donates, creating a positively charged ion—the Na⁺ cation.

words.ex: The sun softened the ice on the road.
words.ex_cn: 太阳使路上的冰变软了。
words.en: To make or become soft or softer.

words.ex: The softness of the pillow provided a comfortable night's sleep.
words.ex_cn: 枕头的柔软度提供了舒适的睡眠。
words.en: The quality or condition of being soft.

words.ex: The workers showed solidarity during the strike.
words.ex_cn: 工人们在罢工期间表现出团结。
words.en: Solidarity is unity or agreement of feeling or action, especially among individuals with a common interest; mutual support within a group.

words.ex: The water will solidify when it gets very cold.
words.ex_cn: 水在非常冷的时候会变凝固。
words.en: If something solidifies or is solidified, it becomes solid or hard.

words.tr: adj. 单独的；独唱的；独奏的；
words.ex: He played a solo guitar piece at the concert.
words.ex_cn: 他在音乐会上演奏了一首独奏吉他曲。
words.en: A solo is a piece of music or a performance done by one person alone, without any accompaniment.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.tr: adj. 悲伤的；使人伤心的
words.ex: He looked sorrowful after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 失去狗后，他看起来很悲伤。
words.en: Feeling or showing sadness; mournful.

words.tr:
n. 最高统治者；君主；元首
adj. 独立自主的；拥有最高统治权的
words.ex: The sovereign makes important decisions for the country.
words.ex_cn: 君主为国家做出重要决定。
words.en: A sovereign is a king, queen, or other supreme ruler.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.ex: She buys soy to make tofu.
words.ex_cn: 她买大豆来做豆腐。
words.en: Soy refers to the beans of a widely cultivated Asian plant that are used as a source of protein and for making products such as tofu and soy sauce.

words.ex: The new house has a spacious living room.
words.ex_cn: 这所新房子有一个宽敞的客厅。
words.en: A spacious room, building, or place is large in size or area, so that you can move around freely in it.

words.tr:
n. 时距；跨度；
v. 跨越；
words.ex: The span of his career was 40 years.
words.ex_cn: 他职业生涯的时距是40年。
words.en: The extent or measure of space between two points or extremities, as of a bridge or a roof; the full extent, stretch, or reach of anything.

words.ex: He has good spatial skills for drawing maps.
words.ex_cn: 他画地图有很好的空间能力。
words.en: Relating to or occupying space.

words.ex: This factory specializes in making electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂专用于制造电动汽车。
words.en: If you specialize in a particular subject or skill, you become an expert in it by focusing your studies or work on it.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: The engineer checked the specification for the machine.
words.ex_cn: 工程师检查了机器的规格。
words.en: A specification is a detailed description of the design and materials used to make something.

words.ex: The fireworks at night were a beautiful spectacle.
words.ex_cn: 夜晚的烟花是一场美丽的奇观。
words.en: A spectacle is a visually striking performance or display.

words.ex: He speculates that it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他推测明天会下雨。
words.en: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.ex: The spectator watched the game quietly.
words.ex_cn: 旁观者安静地观看了比赛。
words.en: A spectator is someone who watches an event, show, game, or activity.

words.ex: The ball is spherical.
words.ex_cn: 这个球是球状的。
words.en: Something that is spherical is round like a ball.

words.ex: She added cinnamon spice to the cake.
words.ex_cn: 她往蛋糕里加了肉桂香料。
words.en: Spice refers to a substance used to flavor food, which is usually made from parts of plants, especially their seeds, fruits, or roots. It can also mean something that adds interest or excitement.

words.tr:
v. 溢出；溅出
n. 溢出；溅出
words.ex: He spilled milk on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶洒在了地上。
words.en: To cause or allow (a liquid, powder, etc.) to flow or fall out of a container, usually by accident.

words.tr:
n. 螺旋形；陡升或骤降；
v. 螺旋式上升（或下降）；
adj. 螺旋形的；
words.ex: The snail moved along a spiral path.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛沿着一个螺旋形的路径爬行。
words.en: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round, with each curve above or outside the previous one.

words.ex: He did it out of spite.
words.ex_cn: 他出于恶意做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something out of spite, you do it because you want to hurt or upset someone.

words.tr: n. 引人注目的人或物；溅污的斑点；
words.ex: The new singer became a splash on the music scene.
words.ex_cn: 这位新歌手成为了音乐界引人注目的人物。
words.en: To cause (a liquid) to scatter in drops or small quantities, especially by striking or moving suddenly; to move or strike so as to cause a liquid to scatter in this way.

words.tr:
v. 分开；分裂；
n. 划分；分歧；
words.ex: The tree split in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 那棵树在风暴中裂开了。
words.en: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

words.ex: The spokesman spoke clearly at the press conference.
words.ex_cn: 发言人在新闻发布会上清晰地发言。
words.en: A spokesman is a man who speaks on behalf of a group or an organization.

words.tr:
n. 球类运动（squash）；
v. 压碎；
words.ex: He plays squash every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每周末和朋友打壁球。
words.en: To squash something means to press or squeeze it so that it becomes flat, soft, or out of shape. It can also refer to the sport of squash or a type of vegetable.

words.tr:
